resolved_findings.problem: Matching could select a REST boundary guard and another WS hour instead of the first fixed candle.
resolved_findings.resolution: Match now filters both REST and WS opens to the first target; rollover regression passes.

resolved_findings.problem: Contradictory explicit ETH symbol or 1m interval was ignored in a BTC/1h witness.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit identity mismatch is rejected; absent identity remains bound to the recorded BTC/1h request.

resolved_findings.problem: Duplicate WS timestamp JSON keys were silently overwritten.
resolved_findings.resolution: Both raw decoders reject duplicate JSON keys while retaining exact Decimal OHLC comparison.

resolved_findings.problem: Object witness was unnecessarily restricted to native WS inclusive close although official docs leave inclusivity unspecified.
resolved_findings.resolution: Native H-1 and H close conventions are accepted for object witness; canonical object close remains open+H-1 and native/canonical deltas are recorded separately.

resolved_findings.problem: Normalized last_close_ms incorrectly pointed to exclusive cutoff while claiming inclusive canonical close.
resolved_findings.resolution: Actual canonical last_close_ms and last_close_exclusive_ms are now distinct; source integration tests assert each.

resolved_findings.problem: Cancelling asyncio.to_thread REST after a fatal WS event could leave a request running without persisted raw response.
resolved_findings.resolution: Pinned native aiohttp with retries disabled replaces thread transport; dispatched REST drains during abort; partial received bytes are saved and rejected without decode.

resolved_findings.problem: dict(websockets.Headers) raised MultipleValuesError for repeated Set-Cookie values.
resolved_findings.resolution: Handshake header pairs preserve duplicate fields; regression passes.
